info.title: FinWise AI
info.description:
**FinWise AI** - AI-powered personal financial decision intelligence (backend).
Don't just track your money. Understand it. Predict it. Make smarter decisions with it.

> FinWise AI provides informational decision support, not guaranteed financial outcomes or regulated professional financial advice.
> Simulations, stress tests and predictions are hypothetical and based on your recorded history.

post.description: Registers via Supabase Auth. Passwords are forwarded to Supabase and never stored/logged by this backend.
Revokes the session at Supabase. Access tokens remain valid until expiry (stateless JWT) - keep their TTL short.
DEV/TEST ONLY: mint a token for local development without Supabase. Disabled unless ALLOW_DEV_AUTH=true and not production.

get.description: Budgets with utilisation, remaining amount, warnings and 3-month history for the given month (default current).
Current financial state derived from stored data. `refresh=true` recomputes detections and saves a snapshot.
